name: AKS Cluster Info
description: Wraps `az aks show` and `kubectl get nodes` to surface current cluster state (node count, k8s version, addon profiles, pool status) as structured JSON for agents. Use before and after any cluster-mutating operation to verify expected state.

resourceGroup.description: Azure resource group containing the AKS cluster.

subscription.description: Azure subscription ID or display name. Defaults to the active `az` CLI subscription if omitted.

includeNodeDetails.description: If true, runs `kubectl get nodes -o json` after `az aks show` and merges node-level detail (status, version, labels, taints) into the response.
